value.rationale: Arbitrary weighted-star diffusion is a natural hub-and-spoke transport class. A nontrivial dimensionless reciprocal-weight boundary completely separates all-step positivity from unique finite-horizon loss for a standard fourth-order A-stable method. The first failing entries and computable scalar root provide graph-structured numerical-step guidance; the four-vertex positive-boundary/counterexample pair shows the sharp phenomenon is not a degree or topology artifact.
